question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "take."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"take"** in this context is to express the action of removing the earrings. (इस संदर्भ में **"take"** का उपयोग करने का कारण बालियां निकालने की क्रिया को व्यक्त करना है।)
 
• The verb** "take"** implies a deliberate and controlled action, suggesting that individuals have the option or necessity to remove the earrings after a few hours.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct paragraph: 

Metal allergies can begin to act up within__ minutes of putting earrings in your ears. Some people can go a few hours before having to __**take**__ the earrings out, but some can barely stand the ______ (3) ______ enough to bother putting earrings in at all. This can be discouraging for those of us ______ (4) ______ love to wear earrings, but fortunately hypoallergenic jewellery for ______ (5) ______ ears exists! 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Hand: **to give or pass something to somebody. (किसी को कुछ देना या आगे बढ़ाना)
 
• **Make: **to produce or create something. (कुछ उत्‍पन्‍न या सृजित करना)
 
• **Expel: **to force somebody to leave a country, school, club, etc.(देश, स्‍कूल आदि से निकाल बाहर करना; निष्‍कासित करना)
